result.title: Confidence-Guided Pseudo-Label Refinement for Unsupervised Cross-Domain Person Re-Identification
result.summary: Unsupervised cross-domain person re-identification remains challenging because domain shifts generate noisy pseudo labels that are reinforced during iterative adaptation. Existing clustering-based methods often rely on limited reliability cues or global confidence criteria and may impose hard identity supervision on ambiguous target samples. To address these limitations, we propose CGPLR, a confidence-guided pseudo-label refinement framework for unsupervised domain-adaptive person re-identification. CGPLR estimates sample-level reliability by jointly modeling centroid compatibility, local neighborhood consistency, separation from the strongest competing cluster and temporal assignment stability. The resulting confidence distribution is used to derive cluster-adaptive upper and lower thresholds for a three-way selective decision. Reliable assignments are preserved, recoverable samples are reassigned only when an alternative cluster receives sufficient geometric and neighborhood support and highly ambiguous samples are deferred from hard identity supervision. The learning objective adapts to these decisions through confidence-weighted supervision for preserved samples, cautious corrected-label weighting for reassigned samples and label-free representation consistency for deferred samples. CGPLR achieves 76.4% Rank-1 accuracy and 47.6% mean average precision (mAP) on Market-1501 to MSMT17, and 95.1% Rank-1 accuracy and 87.7% mAP on MSMT17 to Market-1501, demonstrating effective reliability-aware selective adaptation. The code is available at https://github.com/Sundas058/CGPLR.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CGPLR，一种面向无监督跨域行人重识别的置信度引导伪标签精炼框架：由质心兼容性、局部邻域一致性、与最强竞争簇的可分性及时间分配稳定性联合估计样本级可靠性，据此导出簇自适应上下阈值做保留／重分配／延后的三路选择性决策，并采用置信加权、谨慎纠正加权与无标签一致性等差异化监督。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「可靠则监督、可疑则重分配、模糊则延后」的三路选择性决策与置信度加权监督，可能为 LVR 中不确定 latent 推理轨迹的监督分配与贡献分配提供可核查的线索；但对象为行人重识别的伪标签噪声，与多模态推理关联较远。
